title: K Manga Adds Kanna Hourai's 'Give 'Em Hell, Miran Yata!!'
content: K MANGA describes its story: Miran Yata, a first year at Flower High School, is already barreling down the path to being a total loner not even two months into the school year! But she's completely unbothered by this.
author: ANN

title: Kodama Tales Licenses Crows, Cyberblue, Beautiful Place, 2 More Manga
content: Kodama Tales announced the following manga licenses daily from Tuesday to Saturday: Shimon Hanazawa decides to enroll at Seishin Girls' Academy as a trooper, an unprecedented move for a prim and proper Advanced Placement student.
author: ANN

title: Let Me Fix You Anime Streams Promotional Video
content: The official YouTube channel for the short anime of Sakura Kurihara 's Let Me Fix You ( Kimi o Tsumugu ) yuri manga streamed a promotional video for the anime on June 21. English manga publisher BluPetal launched a Kickstarter campaign on March 13 to release the manga in English.
author: ANN

title: Spirits & Cat Ears Manga Ends After 12 Years
content: The August issue of Kadokawa 's Comic Cune issue published the final chapter of Miyuki Nakayama 's Spirits & Cat Ears ( Kudamimi no Neko ) manga on Friday. Kadokawa plans to publish the final volumes, 12 and 13, simultaneously at the end of this year.
author: ANN

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: Cloudy Beach Anime Film Streams Worldwide on July 13
content: Kadokawa announced on Monday that the SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: CLOUDY BEACH anime film will stream worldwide beginning on July 13. The anime will stream on Netflix in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, and the Middle East.
author: ANN

title: A New Dawn Anime Film, Takopi's Original Sin TV Anime Win at Annecy
content: A New Dawn film opened in Japan on March 6. The film was originally slated to open last year, but was delayed to this year. Yoshitoshi Shinomiya directed, conceived the story, and wrote the film's script. Utsushita ( Heavenly Delusion ) designed the characters. Akiko Majima ( Suzume ) served as an artist.
author: ANN

title: Art of Fighting 3 Gets 'Revamped' Art of Fighting 3 R Version With King, Yuri
content: SNK announced The Path of the Warrior: Art of Fighting 3 R , a "revamped" version of the company's 1996 fighting game Art of Fighting 3: The Path of the Warrior , during the Evo fighting game tournament on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: New 'King of Prism' Movie 'Tri-Star Act' Announced
content: The KING OF PRISM SUPER LIVE Prism☆Tours! event announced a new anime movie in the franchise, subtitled Tri-Star Act , on Sunday. The official site also revealed the returning staff and cast, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Virtua Fighter Crossroads Game Teases Bakunawa Killer Character in Trailer
content: Sega presented a new trailer for its Virtua Fighter Crossroads game during the Evo fighting game tournament on Sunday. The video announces the addition of the new masked character Bakunawa Killer.
author: ANN
